<div class="intro-text">

<p>
I am Yesmine Ayeb, an Agronomy Engineer with an MSc in Horticultural Genetics & Biotechnology.
</p>

<p>
My background combines horticultural production and plant molecular biology. Through my studies and research experience, I have developed a strong interest in plant responses to stress and the phytomicrobiome, while remaining curious about a broad range of emerging topics in plant science.
</p>

<p>
I am always happy to connect with researchers and professionals in plant science and biotechnology. If you would like to discuss research, collaboration, or potential opportunities, please feel free to reach out.
</p>
